refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback highlights four main improvement areas: (1) Add explicit minimum cardinality constraints (owl:minCardinality 1) for critical properties, especially :hasInvoiceLineAssignment on :InvoiceMessage, to ensure at least one line item per invoice (HIGH priority). (2) Model property chains or SWRL rules for automatic inference of total invoice amounts from line items and taxes (MEDIUM priority). (3) Enrich EDIFACT segment and element structure with controlled vocabularies for segment codes (e.g., BGM, NAD) and element codes, as individuals or SKOS concepts (MEDIUM priority). (4) Add usage examples as annotation properties (LOW priority). All CQs are already fully covered. No constraint violations identified. Plan: (A) Add owl:minCardinality 1 restriction for :hasInvoiceLineAssignment on :InvoiceMessage. (B) Add property chain axiom for invoice line summation (as annotation, since OWL2 DL does not support arithmetic). (C) Add controlled vocabulary individuals for segment codes BGM and NAD. (D) Optionally, add annotation property for usage example. (E) Preserve all existing correct structure and annotations.
